test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between D and H. E sits fourth to the left of J. Only D is between E and I. J sits third to the right of F. Who sits at the second position from the right end of the row?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Given: Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only three people sit between D and H. Only D is between E and I.

(There are two possibility)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb57ba1e1a17fa9e668cd716839f8e7292042a52640c949fe6494351529eb44a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/524d3eff21aafd2b6ec541d98897cb27acf1beeb159405edc3ead3e51a815b71.png] 

2) E sits fourth to the left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d70bbbe7e35a9ae2c4acd39fe43752955114e31819fc2f80e7532ef431eceb8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/199015d94425890f26999658c5411e9b972c1dd967eca62e9f007de5202203a4.png] 

3) J sits third to the right of F. So, case 1 will be eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ae196b40472ba727dc834f0e6e7a378f1e70273f83237286e53e1947604dc0.png] 

5) G sits on the vacant place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3baa50df335d37475d6e35cfd36ba92d586a22d8a93db57e2ba4adb1da43b224.png] ​

Clearly, H is sitting second to the right end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "H".
